overview: Before a launch, sale or press mention, we find out where your app will struggle and fix it. We run load tests that mimic real visitors, watch where things slow down and then add the right remedy: caching, a bigger database plan, more app servers behind a load balancer or automatic scaling. You get the test results and a clear note on how many users the set-up can handle.

faq: How many users can it handle afterwards?
We measure it. After the changes we run the test again and tell you the load where response times start to slip. We do not promise a number up front because it depends on your code and data.
Will scaling make my hosting bill much bigger?
Not necessarily. Caching often lowers cost. Auto scaling adds servers only when traffic rises and removes them after. We show the likely monthly range for each traffic level.
Do you test on my live site?
We prefer a staging copy, because heavy tests can slow real customers. If only live is possible, we run light tests at a quiet hour and agree the limit with you first.
Is my app ready to scale as it is?
Some apps need code changes first, for example if they store files on one server's disk. The test shows this, and we say clearly if the fix is bigger than the package.
